completion:
```sql
alter table public.roadmap_items enable row level security;
alter table public.item_votes enable row level security;

create policy "roadmap_items_select_all"
  on public.roadmap_items
  for select
  to anon, authenticated
  using (true);

create policy "item_votes_select_authenticated"
  on public.item_votes
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (true);

create policy "item_votes_insert_self"
  on public.item_votes
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (user_id = auth.uid() and exists (select 1 from public.roadmap_items r where r.id = item_id and r.status <> 'shipped'));

create policy "item_votes_delete_self"
  on public.item_votes
  for delete
  to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid());
```
